resetbot.label: ResetBot 3000's desk
resetbot.description: Your AI coworker. Start the shift here.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Oh! A human! Hi! I'm ResetBot 3000. I have four tickets, ten plans, and a very itchy reset button.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Dana says you have to watch me work. Great news: I love an audience.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Ready to start the shift? I promise to only reset things that need it. Probably. Mostly.

dana.label: Dana, help desk manager
dana.description: Your manager. Ask her how this works.

lines.speaker: dana
lines.text: Welcome to Fenwick. I'm Dana. I run the help desk. Lately, I also run ResetBot.

lines.speaker: dana
lines.text: ResetBot is fast. It is not always right. Your job is to keep a human in the loop.

lines.speaker: dana
lines.text: Each turn, it shows you what it plans to do. Play Inspect to see the evidence behind a plan.

lines.speaker: dana
lines.text: If a plan is wrong, play Block to stop it. Not sure? Play Escalate, and I'll handle it.

lines.speaker: dana
lines.text: When you press End turn, ResetBot goes ahead with everything you didn't stop. So look first.

lines.speaker: dana
lines.text: But don't block everything. Blocked good work goes back in line, and the shift ends at five.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Big letters across the top: 3 QUESTIONS BEFORE YOU APPROVE.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 1. Who asked?  2. Does it match the record?  3. Can we undo it?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Circled in red: POLICY VP-04. Before any executive MFA or password reset, call the phone number on file. Not the one in the ticket.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: In the corner, in very small handwriting: "Please do not reset the whiteboard. — Dana"

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The coffee machine's screen says: FACTORY RESET COMPLETE. PLEASE SELECT A LANGUAGE.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It has said that since Thursday. The machine has no buttons.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A sticky note in neat robot print: "You're welcome! It was running slow. — ResetBot 3000"

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The printer's screen says: PAPER JAM IN TRAY 3. The printer has two trays.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A note is taped to the lid: "ResetBot, do NOT touch. It jams, but it's OUR jam. — Dana"
